title: Exploring roles of the chitinase ChiC in modulating Pseudomonas aeruginosa virulence phenotypes
projectDescription: Proteins were precipitated using chloroform and methanol, by the protocol described by Wessel and Flügge (1984). Following precipitation, the proteins were reduced and alkylated before being digested, cleaned and desalted using STrap tips (Zougman A, Selby PJ, Banks RE. 2014). The peptide samples were analyzed by a nano UPLC (nanoElute, Bruker) coupled to a trapped ion mobility spectrometry and a quadrupole time of flight mass spectrometer (timsTOF Pro, Bruker).
sampleProcessingProtocol: MS raw files were processed with the MaxQuant software suite (version 2.2.0.0) for label-free quantification using 'match between runs. The proteins were matched against the UniProt proteome: UP000000653. The data was filtered to 1% FDR. Perseus (2.0.7.0) was used to analyze the data.
